info.text:
Miss the 10 best days in 20 years, end with 56% less.
$10,000 in the S&P 500 (dividends reinvested) from 2006 to 2025 grew to $80,619 left alone (11.0% a year).
Missing only the 10 best days: $35,866 (6.6% a year).
6 of the 10 best days came within 2 weeks of the 10 worst. March 12, 2020: -9.5%. March 13: +9.3%.
Sources: J.P. Morgan Asset Management, Guide to Retirement 2026; S&P 500 daily closes, March 2020.
News and education, not financial advice.
